scope: H2 bounded page writer component. Integrates BinPagePool and bounded write credits to store one ordered chain of immutable primitive/state references. Not connected to RenderCore, a multi-tile directory or replay engine; legacy eight-record TileDrawBinner limit remains. Original H0-H8 goal is unchanged.

configuration.supported_page_bytes: Power of two64..65536, inherited from BinPagePool.
configuration.storage: One pending reference and bounded control/write queues, not the proposed32KiB primitive/state cache. External pages remain software-owned; no new on-chip array capacity is claimed.

memory_abi.byte_order: Explicit32-bit little-endian memory words, independent of Bundle packing.
header_words: nextPageAddress (zero terminates; headValid separately permits a head at address zero)
memory_abi.primitive_state_contract: Opaque32-bit handles. The caller supplies immutable, ownership-checked records; this writer does not fetch or validate referenced primitive/state resources.
memory_abi.sequence: Strictly increasing unsigned32 sequence within a binding; gaps allowed. Repeat or wrap fails before storing that reference.

commit_contract.initialization: All header stores acknowledge before a page is linked; all four reference stores acknowledge before its count store is admitted.
commit_contract.commit_point: Successful acknowledgement of the count store. Append success and committed-count events occur exactly once at that point.
commit_contract.exhaustion: No new reference store on allocation failure. Return the exact reference/token and a usable completed prefix with head/tail/count. Stop append admission until end/cancel. A higher-level controller must consume the prefix and restart the uncommitted reference without violating tile order.
commit_contract.fault: An errored write may already have changed memory. Drain all offered/issued writes and invalidate the whole binding; no usable prefix is advertised. The returned count is the last known successful commit count.
commit_contract.cancellation: Preserve a stalled offered memory request and already offered append reply. A count store acknowledged during cancel drain is still counted and returns immutable append success; final binding completion remains cancelled/unusable.
commit_contract.rebind: No new binding until write/allocation/append ownership drains and completion retires. The caller must separately drain dependent readers before recycling an arena.
commit_contract.visibility: Acknowledgements complete this memory port. Publication/invalidation in dependent cache domains is a separate integration responsibility; no CPU coherence or cached-reader visibility is inferred.

coverage: Twenty references span four128-byte pages at credits1/3/8. Decode every memory word/reference in sequence, with reordered acknowledgements and backpressure.
Exhaust two64-byte pages after four commits, return exact fifth reference, then rebind/retry to obtain the exact concatenated five-reference stream.
Header/link/payload/count-store faults, including a faulted count store that modifies the memory model; prefix must be unusable.
Fault recovery with different context/pass/generation/tile on reused addresses; every offered append reply/completion and page header carries the new owner.
Cancel a stalled offered write; do not withdraw it or complete before its acknowledgement.
Cancel before a count store acknowledges; count its eventual successful physical commit once, keep reply stable, fail final binding.
Preserve an already offered success reply during cancellation.
Reject unsupported descriptor, duplicate/wrapped sequence; handle empty arena/bin.
Last reference word at0xfffffffc with exclusive4GiB limit.
Default4096-byte pages with256 references: page counts254/2 and global count256, exact high-bit address/counter boundaries.
Successful/failed allocation events, byte events and final commit/page accounting checked through stalls and reuse.
functional.cycle_scope: Cycles include scripted request/response/append/completion stalls. These are control-component workloads, not realistic full-frame/binning throughput or a GPU scaling result.
functional.proof_limit: Numeric/protocol simulation with independent memory decode and commit/ownership checks; no universal temporal formal proof.

initial_failure.cause: Global stop handler reasserted abortDrain and prevented exit to pool completion. Exclude abortDrain so its own drain/reply/completion transitions can proceed.

emission.test_refinement: Owner assertions and default-page stress were added after emission; all production source hashes and every frozen SV byte remain unchanged.
